Context: 12. Assistance to Government servants in legal proceedings

5. (iii) Cases filed by a Government servant on his being required to vindicate his official conduct.Interest-free advance will be sanctioned to him for the purpose. The extent of reimbursement by the Government will be decided considering to what extent the Court has vindicated the acts of the Government servant in the proceedings.
